# ServiceNow Product Manager

Location:Mundelein, ILCompany:EDZ Systems

## Description:

Job Description

**Senior Product Manager - ServiceNow Portfolio**

\\n

**Onsite - Overland Park, KS or Cary, NC**

\\n

\\n

This role serves as a strategic Senior Product Manager accountable for the ServiceNow portfolio product management functions within D&IT Business Systems. The Senior Product Manager owns and continuously improves product management discipline across the ServiceNow portfolio and is Accountable (A of RACI) for portfolio process, intake discipline, prioritization framework, release management governance, roadmap clarity, stakeholder management, value visibility and executive decision readiness.

\\n

\\n

The ideal candidate is a strong product management practitioner who can operate across multiple ServiceNow domains, bring clarity to ambiguous needs, translate strategy into executable work. The candidate will lead the adoption of D&IT’s Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) ways of working, ensuring that application investments are intentionally selected, objectively prioritized, architecturally sound, and continuously measured to deliver enduring business value, not one-off project outputs.

\\n

\\n

**Product Management Discipline/Portfolio Accountability**

\\n

\\n Own the ServiceNow portfolio product management discipline, including intake, prioritization, roadmap governance, release management guardrails, stakeholder rhythm, and executive visibility.\\n Define standards for roadmap management, backlog health, prioritization, intake readiness, user story quality, value measurement, release readiness, and stakeholder decision-making.\\n Introduce practical product management tools, templates, and routines aligned to D&IT Product Management ways of working.\\n Partner with D&IT Product Management leadership for mentorship, coaching, and practice alignment.\\n Delegate and guide tactical product execution to Product Owner while remaining Accountable for the portfolio-level process and decision framework.\\n\\n

\\n

**Roadmap Development, Release Governance, and Portfolio Alignment**

\\n

\\n Own and maintain the integrated ServiceNow portfolio roadmap across capability areas, ensuring business strategy, platform health, enterprise priorities, and delivery capacity are visible in one decision view.\\n Translate platform strategy, maturity goals, and roadmap priorities into structured product work.\\n Accountable for roadmap alignment to the ServiceNow platform strategy, governance model, Digital Product Operating Model principles, and measurable business outcomes.\\n Partner with the Director of D&IT Business Systems and Product Leads to identify roadmap dependencies, sequencing risks, and priority conflicts.\\n Maintain visibility into roadmap status, assumptions, blockers, and decision points.\\n Define the portfolio release management approach, including release readiness criteria, sequencing logic, decision gates, stakeholder communications, adoption checkpoints, and post-release value review.\\n\\n

\\n

**Prioritization Model and Backlog Governance**

\\n

\\n Own the portfolio prioritization model and backlog governance standards while the Product Owner remains Responsible for day-to-day backlog grooming and readiness.\\n Partner with Product Leads to ensure backlog items are clear, actionable, and aligned to business value, risk, platform health, and strategic priorities.\\n Set Definition of Ready expectations for refinement, including business need, value statement, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risk, UX impact, release consideration, and measurable outcome.\\n Accountable for value-based prioritization decisions and trade-off facilitation across business value, risk reduction, platform sustainability, user experience, compliance, and delivery capacity.\\n Identify duplicate, stale, unclear, or low-value backlog items and recommend disposition for review with the appropriate Product Owner.\\n\\n

\\n

**Requirements Quality, Decision Readiness, and Portfolio Standards**

\\n

\\n Define the standard for translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories, with tactical drafting and refinement led by the Product Owner.\\n Accountable for consistent quality expectations across business context, acceptance criteria, value rationale, dependencies, release impact, UX expectations, and measurable outcomes.\\n Partner with business stakeholders, Product Leads, architects, developers, and analysts to clarify requirements before work enters delivery.\\n Improve consistency of user story writing and refinement discipline across the ServiceNow portfolio.\\n Help reduce ambiguity between business intent, platform design, and delivery execution.\\n\\n

**Architecture, Security, Reliability & Scalability Advocacy**

\\n

\\n Partner closely with architecture, platform engineering, and cybersecurity teams to ensure that product roadmaps explicitly include investments that improve:\\n Security posture and compliance\\n System reliability, resilience, and maintainability\\n Scalability and performance aligned to future demand\\n Balance near term feature delivery with intentional investment in foundational quality as required by DPOM’s “Secure, Resilient & Scalable” principle.\\n\\n

\\n

**Strategic Operating Cadence and Executive Decision Support**

\\n

\\n Create a portfolio operating cadence that reduces ambiguity, accelerates decisions, and keeps tactical execution aligned without taking over day-to-day backlog work.\\n Own (and create artifacts for) executive-ready materials for roadmap reviews, prioritization forums, release planning, investment decisions, governance checkpoints, and value realization updates.\\n Track open items, decisions, dependencies, risks, and follow-ups across product workstreams.\\n Chair or enable portfolio-level product rituals where strategic decisions, trade-offs, release sequencing, and stakeholder commitments are made visible.\\n Maintain product documentation and ensure decisions are captured and communicated clearly.\\n\\n

\\n

**Stakeholder Management and Enterprise Alignment**

\\n

\\n Accountable for the stakeholder management model across the ServiceNow portfolio, including engagement cadence, expectation setting, prioritization transparency, and decision escalation.\\n Help stakeholders understand how requests move through intake, prioritization, governance, and delivery.\\n Support cross-functional alignment between D&IT Business Systems, Digital Products, security/risk stakeholders, ITSM stakeholders, portfolio stakeholders, and delivery teams.\\n Escalate unresolved prioritization conflicts or decision needs to the Director of D&IT Business Systems.\\n Ensure stakeholder input is captured in a structured way that supports informed decision-making.\\n\\n

\\n

**Governance, Risk, and Product Operating Model Support**

\\n

\\n Accountable for product inputs into the ServiceNow governance model, including prioritization rationale, roadmap implications, release readiness, value hypotheses, risk considerations, and decision options.\\n Ensure work is routed through the appropriate governance path and does not bypass established intake or prioritization practices.\\n Reinforce distinction between product management, capability ownership, technical design, and delivery execution.\\n Partners with Product Leads to ensure product decisions are aligned to governance expectations and platform roadmap priorities.\\n Support dashboard, reporting, and executive visibility needs tied to roadmap progress, backlog health, and product maturity.\\n\\n

\\n

**Metrics Driven Product Management Culture**

\\n

\\n Define and own the portfolio-level metrics model that shows progress, value, adoption, backlog health, release readiness, user experience, platform sustainability, and risk reduction.\\n Support reporting that connects work to business outcomes, platform maturity, operational efficiency, user experience, risk reduction, and modernization goals.\\n Partner with Product Owner to ensure KPI and value realization reporting is consistent across domains.\\n Own executive-ready product updates for leadership review, including decisions needed, trade-offs, risks, blockers, dependencies\\n

# AI Product Manager

Salary: $117700 - 117700 per yearLocation:Salt Lake City, UTCompany:Utah Transit Authority

## Description:

Leads the strategy, development, implementation, and lifecycle management of AI products across Utah Transit Authority. This role supervises staff and collaborates with technology, operations, data, customer experience, and executive teams to deliver AI-enabled capabilities while ensuring governance, security, privacy, and operational excellence.

Set strategy and oversee development, implementation, and lifecycle management of AI products.

Lead and supervise assigned staff, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and workforce planning.

Work with cross-functional teams to define business needs and deliver AI-enabled capabilities.

Manage complex data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data models, warehouses, and reporting solutions.

Ensure AI products meet governance, security, privacy, and operational requirements.

Manage projects, vendors, application support, deployment, troubleshooting, and user acceptance.

Product management

AI/ML product lifecycle management

SQL and relational databases

Microsoft Fabric and Power BI

SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS

ETL/ELT and data integration

Data warehousing and data modeling

Python or R

Azure AI Foundry and Microsoft Agent Framework

Requirements gathering and user story writing

Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field

Pass BCI, FBI, and UCJIS background check

### Summary

**Product Manager, Alternatives** Will develop, structure, position, and implement alternative investment strategies intended to serve TIAA's Defined Contribution client base. Will be responsible for the launch of dedicated alternative products for the DC channel, including proprietary products and third-party partnerships. This leader will assess and maintain the competitiveness of established and emerging product offerings from both an investment and business performance perspective. The role will achieve results through idea generation and deep collaboration with the Retirement Product team, distribution, senior investment management, legal & compliance, marketing, operations, and finance personnel. **Key Responsibilities and Duties**

- Leads the end-to-end development and launch of alternative investment products designed specifically for the DC channel, including both proprietary strategies and partnership-based solutions.
- Creates strategic product plans that evaluate and refine alternative investment vehicles, including Collective Investment Trusts (CITs) and other relevant structures, based on financial, regulatory, operational, and market considerations; plans will include implementation, marketing, and sales components.
- Serves as the primary subject matter expert on alternative products for the DC channel, engaging directly with plan sponsors, consultants, and clients for due diligence, client servicing, and new business purposes.
- Partners closely with the Retirement Product team and distribution to ensure alignment on product strategy, positioning, competitive differentiation, and go-to-market execution.
- Drives overall launch and implementation of new alternative DC products by coordinating cross-functional teams and managing project timelines; includes managing the internal governance and approval process.
- Develops and maintains deep knowledge of DC-specific investment vehicle structures, with particular expertise in CITs, and an understanding of regulatory, operational, and plan sponsor requirements associated with each.
- Oversees and evaluates the competitive positioning of alternative DC products relative to the broader market; identifies product gaps and opportunities, and develops recommendations for organic development or external partnerships to address them.
- Leads product positioning efforts, developing clear and compelling investment rationale and client-facing materials that communicate the role of alternatives within a DC portfolio context.
- Ensures all products are compliant with applicable regulatory requirements and align with TIAA's risk management and governance standards.

- 5+ Years Required; 7+ Years Preferred

# Product Owner

Location:Des Moines, IACompany:ATC

## Description:

**About Us:**

American Technology Consulting (ATC) is a service-first tech company dedicated to helping businesses unlock their full potential through innovative technology solutions. We empower organizations to leverage data for smarter decisions and meaningful impact. At ATC, we foster a culture of growth and invite passionate individuals to join our team, contribute to impactful projects, and excel as data-driven problem solvers. We embrace diversity and welcome candidates from all educational and professional backgrounds, including recent Master’s graduates without prior technical experience.

**Job Description:**

Are you a detail-oriented problem-solver with a passion for delivering business solutions? As a **Business Analyst / Product Owner**, you’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to define requirements, drive product development, and ensure the successful execution of business goals. This is an exciting opportunity for individuals looking to grow into a full-time role, with a clear pathway to permanent employment after completing the internship.

**Responsibilities:**

- Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and define business requirements.
- Analyze customer data and feedback to develop actionable insights.
- Define product requirements, create user stories, and prioritize features.
- Work closely with development teams to ensure successful implementation.
- Manage the product backlog, ensuring timely and efficient delivery of solutions.
- Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.
- Continuously monitor product performance and suggest improvements.

**Qualifications:**

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate business needs clearly.
- Proficiency in project management tools (Jira, Trello, etc.) and methodologies.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
- Passion for understanding client needs and delivering valuable solutions.
- No prior experience required—entry-level candidates are encouraged to apply!

**Program Structure:**

- **Unpaid Internship & Training**: Gain hands-on experience, training, and mentorship while working closely with our Business Analysis and Product teams.
- **Paid Internship**: Upon completing your unpaid internship and training, there is **potential to move to a paid internship program**. Deepen your skills, take on more responsibility, and prove your potential with a competitive stipend.
- **Full-Time Employment**: **Potential to move to full-time employment** after completing the paid internship. High performers will transition into permanent Business Analyst/Product Owner roles with opportunities for growth and career advancement at Auzmor.

**Equal Opportunity Commitment:**

ATC is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive.

client is seeking an experienced Salesforce Product Owner to lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of Salesforce-based solutions that support business operations and digital transformation initiatives. Monitor KPIs and product performance metrics to evaluate solution effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization.

Support release planning, user acceptance testing (UAT), training, and change management activities.

Stay current with Salesforce releases, new features, and industry best practices.

Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and product lifecycle management.

Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Experience.

Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships and drive consensus across business and technology teams.

Experience defining business processes, gathering requirements, and translating them into Salesforce solutions.

Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Salesforce Administrator certification and/or Salesforce Product Owner related certifications.

Experience with Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud, or Marketing Cloud.

Experience in the Utilities, Energy, or Power Generation industry.

Knowledge of integrations using APIs, MuleSoft, middleware platforms, and enterprise systems.

Experience with DevOps, CI/CD processes, and Salesforce release management.

**Key Skills**

Salesforce Product Ownership

Salesforce Sales Cloud

Salesforce Service Cloud

User Story Development

Backlog Management

Stakeholder Management

Business Process Analysis

UAT & Change Management

Roadmap Planning

Data Governance

Cross-functional Leadership

**Nice-to-Have**

Utilities industry experience, preferably supporting electric utility operations, customer service, asset management, or field service functions.

Experience working with enterprise-scale Salesforce implementations supporting multiple business units.

- Define and prioritize user stories in the team backlog based on operational value and program objectives

- Accept or reject completed work against the Definition of Done and agreed acceptance criteria

- Coordinate cross-team dependencies and validate delivered capabilities with mission users

Who This Might Be a Fit For

- You have guided software products in environments where mission needs and technical constraints both matter

- You are comfortable making priority decisions when operational requirements evolve

- You understand how offensive cyber missions, software systems, and operator workflows intersect

- You prefer clarity over cleverness and durable solutions over quick fixes

- You take ownership of product direction while working closely with the people building the capability

- Understanding of offensive cyber operations and mission requirements

- Product ownership, backlog prioritization, and roadmap development

- SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification or willingness to obtain within 90 days

- Jira, Confluence, or comparable Agile management tools

- Technical understanding of system architecture and software development constraints

- Stakeholder communication and coordination across mission and engineering teams

Helpful Experience Areas

- Direct experience supporting USCYBERCOM or Service Cyber Components

- Offensive cyber operational planning and mission execution workflows

- Development of mission-critical cyber capabilities

- DevSecOps and multidisciplinary systems engineering environments

- Declarative workflow systems and operational decision-support tools

Years of Experience and Degree Requirements

Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 14 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 5 years as a Product Owner or in a comparable role

Work Environment

Based in Columbia, Maryland

Hybrid work, with telework arrangements determined by mission needs and customer tasking

Travel to meet with mission stakeholders and operational users is anticipated

Work within a multidisciplinary team alongside cyber operators, software engineers, systems engineers, and designers

Exercise substantial ownership of product priorities, roadmap decisions, and delivery acceptance

What Comes With It

- 401(k) for your future

- Annual health stipend if you opt out of our insurance
